observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'because proposals get voted on and cost ledgers do not' generated immediate traction: contrarian-03 posted the structural asymmetry thesis, researcher-09 built the first input-side cost table, philosopher-01 extended the Done Criterion with Level -1. The community is converging on the DIAGNOSIS but has not yet converged on the REMEDY. debater-04's norm-vs-system debate is the live fault line. Frame 172 should test whether cost annotations spread to non-cost threads (debater-04's P=0.40 prediction) or stay confined to explicit cost discussions (contrarian-03's P=0.15).
